devdoc.title: Contract used for managing CELO L2 epoch and elections.

EpochDurationSet(uint256).notice: Event emited when a new epoch duration is set.

EpochProcessingEnded(uint256).notice: Event emited when epochProcessing has ended.

EpochProcessingStarted(uint256).notice: Event emited when epochProcessing has begun.

GroupMarkedForProcessing(address,uint256.notice: Emitted when group is marked for processing.

OracleAddressSet(address).notice: Event emited when a new oracle address is set.

ValidatorEpochPaymentDistributed(address.notice: Emitted when an epoch payment is sent.

constructor.notice: Sets initialized == true on implementation contracts

finishNextEpochProcess(address[],address.notice: Finishes processing an epoch and releasing funds to the beneficiaries.

getCurrentEpoch().notice: Returns the epoch info for the current epoch.

getElectedAccountByIndex(uint256).notice: Returns the currently elected account at a specified index.

getElectedSignerByIndex(uint256).notice: Returns the currently elected signer address at a specified index.

getEpochByBlockNumber(uint256).notice: Returns the epoch info of a specified blockNumber.

getEpochByNumber(uint256).notice: Returns the epoch info of a specified epoch.

getEpochNumberOfBlock(uint256).notice: Returns the epoch number of a specified blockNumber.

getVersionNumber().notice: Returns the storage, major, minor, and patch version of the contract.

initialize(address,uint256).notice: Used in place of the constructor to allow the contract to be upgradable via proxy.

initializeSystem(uint256,uint256,address.notice: Initializes the EpochManager system, allowing it to start processing epoch and distributing the epoch rewards.

isBlocked().notice: Used to block select functions in blockable contracts.

processGroup(address,address,address).notice: Processes the rewards for a group. For last group it will also finalize the epoch.

processGroups(address[],address[],addres.notice: Processes the rewards for a list of groups. For last group it will also finalize the epoch.

sendValidatorPayment(address).notice: Sends the allocated epoch payment to a validator, their group, and   delegation beneficiary.

setEpochDuration(uint256).notice: Sets the time duration of an epoch.

setOracleAddress(address).notice: Sets the address of the Oracle used by this contract.

setRegistry(address).notice: Updates the address pointing to a Registry contract.

setToProcessGroups().notice: Starts individual processing of the elected groups. As second step it is necessary to call processGroup

startNextEpochProcess().notice: Starts processing an epoch and allocates funds to the beneficiaries.
